topPRs.title: Add missing chains to schema validation anyOf array
topPRs.author: Zentex1337
topPRs.body:
## Summary
- Added 5 chains that were missing from the TOKEN_DATA_SCHEMA anyOf validation array:
  - celo
  - celo-sepolia
  - swellchain
  - ink
  - ink-sepolia

These chains are defined in `chains.ts` and `types.ts` but were not included in the schema validation. This could cause validation to incorrectly reject tokens that only specify these chains as their deployment target.

## Test plan
- Cross-referenced with chains.ts and types.ts to verify all supported chains are now included
- The schema dynamically generates properties from NETWORK_DATA, but the anyOf array requires manual maintenance
